general_information.Description: This course covering basic to advanced digital concepts with an emphasis on problem solving, troubleshooting, and applications. Furthermore, it equips students fundamentals of digital logic design with VHDL. Topics covered: Introductory concepts; Number Systems, Operations and Codes; Logic Gates; Boolean Algebra and Logic Simplifications; Combinational Logic Analysis; Functions of Combinational Logic; Latches, Flip-Flops and Timers; Counters; Shift Registers; Memory and Storage and Introduction to Digital Logic Design with VHDL.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination. '- Student is responsible to do all exercises and practical given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time. Do quizzes during class. - Constantly follow announcements on intranet/CMS at http://cms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information.
general_information.Tools: Technical facilities: Electronics basic components, Logic gates, Combinational Digital ICs Software: - Multisim CD-ROM (Student Edition) http://multisim.en.softonic.com/ - ISE WebPACK Design Software http://www.xilinx.com/support/download.html
